research_notes: Two waves identified: Series 1 (8 designs, Jan 2026 WDW, May 2026 Disney Store US, also EU/Asia Disney Store) and Series 2 (8 designs, Oct 2026 Magic Kingdom, single source). All per-pin facts are character + film only; no source seen gives per-pin numbering, SKUs, or design descriptions. No chaser/LE variants reported for either wave. Film attributions are general knowledge, not from sources. Disney Store UK availability/GBP price not verified from an allowed source. No evidence of a Disneyland Paris release.
time_and_difficulty: Moderate. WebFetch failed with DNS errors for every host, and a plain curl through the session proxy was refused (403, organization egress policy) for wdwnt.com, disneypinsblog.com and disneystore.asia, so no page was read directly; I did not retry or work around this. All facts come from WebSearch result summaries of official/news pages, which is weaker than direct reading. Series 2 relies on a single fan-blog source.
